author: Hola
body:
Plug.dj is a great place to get to know the community and such and IMO should be encouraged going to a lot more. This could be done like on mineplex (I think) by putting something like: "Go play your music and listen to other community members' music at plug.dj/avicus" to the in game tips. 
Sorry for this not being well worded, I can't be fucked to make it better.
